# Brown University Department of Sociology

> > The Department of Sociology at Brown University offers PhD and master's programs with faculty research spanning political sociology, labor politics, educational inequality, race and ethnicity, and global social change.

The department features renowned scholars including Nitsan Chorev, Patrick Heller, Josh Pacewicz, Andrew Schrank, and Han Zhang, with strong connections to the Watson Institute and the Center for the Study of Race and Ethnicity in America (CSREA). Research addresses pressing social issues from school finance reform to nationalism, Ukrainian labor movements to microcredit and gender dynamics.

## Key Topics

- Political sociology
- Labor politics and unions
- Educational inequality
- Race and ethnicity studies
- School finance reform
- Dissertation research
- PhD program
- Global social change
- Watson Institute partnerships
- American Sociological Association
- Nationalism and geopolitics
- Gender and development
- Social Data Analytics
- Faculty publications and awards
- Graduate student achievements

## Faculty Research and Publications

- [Han Zhang's Science Advances Publication](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2025-11-17/han-zhang-has-paper-published-science-advances): Han Zhang publishes nationalism research in Science Advances journal

- [Emily Rauscher's Brookings Publication](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2026-01-27/emily-rauscher-publishes-brookings-institution): Emily Rauscher publishes Brookings paper on school finance reform inequality
- [Michael Kennedy on Ukraine](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2022-05-04/professor-michael-kennedy): Michael Kennedy's course examines Ukraine conflict and global social change
- [Russia-Ukraine Crisis Analysis](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2020-02-03/nothing-simple): Michael Kennedy analyzes Russia-Ukraine crisis and geopolitical tensions

## Faculty Recognition and Leadership

- [Prudence Carter as CSREA Director](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2024-05-24/prudence-carter-announced-director-csrea): Prudence Carter appointed director of Center for Race and Ethnicity Studies
- [Jayanti Owens as William T. Grant Scholar](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2020-04-06/william-t-grant-scholar): Jayanti Owens selected as 2020 William T. Grant Scholar for education research
- [Lisa Di Carlo's President's Award](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2024-04-02/lisa-di-carlo): Lisa Di Carlo receives President's Award for Faculty Governance excellence
- [Meghan Kallman's Transit Initiative](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2022-09-09/dr-meghan-kallman): Meghan Kallman's proposed free RIPTA R-Line transit pilot program launches

## Recent Dissertation Defenses

- [Keenan Wilder's Defense](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2025-03-14/dr-keenan-wilder-successfully-defends): Keenan Wilder defends dissertation on Tunisian unions and labor politics
- [Salma Mutwafy's Defense](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2024-05-28/dr-salma-mutwafy-successfully-defends): Salma Mutwafy defends dissertation on future of work and job-seeking
- [Liz Brennan's Defense](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2022-03-22/dr-brennan): Liz Brennan defends dissertation on electronic health records and autonomy
- [Kristen McNeill's Defense](https://sociology.brown.edu/news/2022-03-31/dr-mcneill): Kristen McNeill defends dissertation on Colombian microcredit and gender
